answer: Let trust propagate through a bounded-length random walk on the attestation graph, restarted from independently anchored honest nodes; a sybil cluster can gain voting mass only through paths crossing its boundary. If that boundary has low conductance, few walk steps enter it, so its aggregate weight is bounded by the stationary mass leaking across the cut, assuming bounded degree and no trusted sybil anchors. A relic, timber, or pulse label changes nothing: connectivity, not naming, determines influence.
